prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a luxurious cinematic AAA fantasy-game environment image for an interactive Christmas toy catalog. Wide 16:9, high resolution 2048x1152 if possible. A completely full-bleed immersive environment, NOT a picture of an open book, NO frame, NO page seam, NO UI, NO labels, NO words, no logos, no watermark, no people. Gorgeous physically rendered materials, deep detailed scenery, golden volumetric light, Christmas enchantment, believable toy-scale objects, richly layered magical setting. The image will be split into two facing pages: keep the narrow middle from x48% to x52% quiet, with no important toy crossing it. EXACTLY SIX main gift toys, each easily distinguishable, visibly separate, large, not touching one another. Three toys in the LEFT HALF, three in the RIGHT HALF. Their composition is naturally staggered across environmental surfaces, never a grid or flat product showcase. Clear toy silhouettes and breathing space. Arrange each half like a triangle: one upper-left, one middle-right, one lower-center. Camera looking slightly down, broad vista with environmental depth, wide enough to see all six entire toys. Secondary decorative items only tiny gift boxes, pine garlands, lamps, snow, lights. Scene: Santa's magnificent golden workshop at midnight, soaring timber roof, hanging brass lanterns, snow through arched windows, intricate toy-making benches, glowing fireplace, pine garlands, miniature mechanical wonders in the far background. LEFT HALF: translucent jewel-colored magnetic tile castle on raised wooden workbench at x14% y37%; lovely little RED WOODEN TRAIN with engine and two carriages at x36% y50%; a rugged RED AND TEAL RC TRUCK with chunky tires foreground at x24% y77%. RIGHT HALF: friendly ORANGE TIN TOY ROBOT on a raised wooden stand at x64% y38%; GREEN TOY DINOSAUR on the bench at x86% y51%; a detailed RED TOY FIRE ENGINE with ladder on the floor foreground at x75% y78%. Every main toy is around 15-24% of image width, separated, brightly lit with warm highlights, luxurious finished toy catalog content inside real magical architecture. Golden amber, ruby red, evergreen, jewel teal. No duplicates of main toys. Make it feel like a frame from an expensive Christmas fantasy game.
